text:
Elon Musk is promoting a video that rewrites the history of Nazism to suit today’s far right. Here’s what happened in 1933, who made the video, and why it matters.

Within weeks of Hitler taking power in January 1933, the organised left was being dismantled. 

Communists, Social Democrats and trade unionists were rounded up, and Dachau opened in March, initially to imprison political opponents, above all Communists. 

On 2 May the Nazis smashed the independent trade unions and replaced them with the state-controlled German Labour Front. A week later, students burned the works of Marx and Kautsky, with a fire oath declaring itself “against class struggle and materialism”.

Dachau’s first murders came on 12 April 1933, when the SS shot four Jewish prisoners: Rudolf Benario, Ernst Goldmann, Arthur Kahn and Erwin Kahn. Benario and Goldmann were young left-wing activists from Fürth.

The very rich were treated differently. Many industrialists had feared the Nazis were socialists, so in January 1932 Hitler addressed Düsseldorf’s Industry Club, playing down his antisemitism and stressing his anti-Marxism to reassure them. Few backed him openly until he took power.

On 20 February 1933, Hitler met leading industrialists, Gustav Krupp among them, and told them: “Private enterprise cannot be maintained in the age of democracy.” It was conceivable, he said, only where people had “a sound idea of authority and personality”. They contributed more than two million Reichsmarks to the election fund of Hitler’s coalition.

Private ownership was preserved for compliant industrialists, company profits rose sharply, and in the mid-1930s the regime even sold state stakes in banks, steelworks and shipping back into private hands.

In 1934, Hitler also had members of his own movement who took its anti-capitalist rhetoric seriously murdered during the Night of the Long Knives.

Yes, the Nazis controlled prices, wages and investment, as Britain did in wartime. State control tells you how an economy is run, and the question that matters is whom it serves.

The Nazi state crushed independent labour, protected compliant employers, and harnessed the economy to rearmament and conquest.

That is why historians place Nazism on the far right, including conservatives such as Ernst Nolte, who saw anti-Marxism as fascism’s defining feature.

The word in the party’s name was largely a recruiting device, designed to lure workers away from the real socialist and communist parties. A name settles nothing, any more than North Korea’s makes it democratic.

The man Musk is amplifying is Brivael Le Pogam, the Paris-based co-founder of Argil, a Silicon Valley-backed company selling AI video avatars, who boasts of using AI to win hundreds of millions of views.

His self-described “masterclass” spends minutes on price controls and the voting habits of American professors. It never once mentions the Holocaust. Race appears once, as “fuel”.

He is candid about why. With Hitler on the right, he complains, anyone defending “borders” or “the nation” is “one step away from fascism”. That is “why Milei is far right” and “why people call Elon Musk a Nazi”. 

A nationalist politics is to be cleansed by relabelling history’s most murderous nationalist.

He even cites Leo Strauss’s “reductio ad Hitlerum”, the fallacy of condemning an idea because Hitler held it, and then commits it from start to finish. And his test of freedom is simply the free market, which would place Pinochet’s Chile, with its torture and disappearances, on the side of freedom.

So the world’s richest man is promoting an attempt to free the far right from its own history, turning the Nazis’ first victims into props for their persecutors.

History records which side Germany’s richest men chose in 1933. It’s worth noticing who is now keen to blur it.

It’s polished, confident and wrong, and it’s built to divide: anyone who objects is cast as the enemy of freedom. Freedom for whom?

Remember who filled Dachau first.

text:
今天认真用了下币安 AI Pro，说实话，有点被震惊到了。
(策略提示词放最后)

前几天我还以为它只能问答，今天把整个流程走完，发现真能把策略做出来，而且已经部署到实盘跑起来了😂

我用的就是海力士那个例子：

ADR 相对韩股溢价达到45%，空 ADR、多韩股；溢价回到35%，两边一起平。换股比例、计价口径这些先统一好。

我把想法告诉它，跟它聊清楚条件，它就生成代码和策略画布，然后测试、部署，最后策略就在账户里运行了。整个操作比我预期简单太多。

以前做过程序的人应该知道，这种策略说起来就两句话，自己搞起来可没那么省事。行情、交易接口、服务器、各种报错，哪一步都得花时间。

这次这些步骤在一个页面里就走完了。看到最后显示“运行中”的时候，我确实觉得，这东西有点意思。

就我这次的体验，这是目前我用过最好用的币圈交易 AI。从开发策略到部署实盘，这一整套做下来，领先感非常明显。

我原来最想要的就是这个：有个交易想法，能不能别让我再折腾一遍基础设施，直接帮我做出来，让我看看究竟能不能用。

现在真的可以了。

当然，目前是部署运行成功，截图时还没触发成交，后续执行稳不稳定、策略赚不赚钱，要继续看。工具好用和策略赚钱是两回事。

但至少以后想到一个策略，我愿意马上打开它试试了。以前不少想法，都是觉得实现起来麻烦，放着放着就没下文了。

币安这次这个产品，建议真做交易、有自己策略想法的人去试一下。光看介绍，跟自己完整跑一遍，感受差挺大的。
--------------------------------------------------
想测试这个策略的【提示词】一键复制：
请帮我创建一个“海力士 ADR 与韩国海力士双合约溢价回归”策略。先生成策略画布并进行模拟交易，不启动实盘。

一、先核实可用性与报价口径

交易标的：
SKHYUSDT：海力士 ADR 永续合约。
SKHYNIXUSDT：韩国上市海力士永续合约。

请先确认：
当前平台能否在同一个策略中操作这两个合约，并根据两者的价格比值触发双腿交易。
两个合约的报价币种、合约乘数、每单位对应的股票数量，以及韩股价格是否已经完成汇率换算。
当前 ADR 与韩国普通股的对应比例。已知公开资料为10份 ADR 对应1股韩国普通股，请核实是否仍然有效。

如果缺少必要数据或不支持其中任何关键功能，请明确说明，不要自行猜测或替换标的。

二、溢价计算

把两腿价格统一为相同币种、相同底层股票数量后，计算 ADR 相对韩国股票的溢价。

若确认合约报价不存在额外缩放，且韩股合约已按每股 USDT 计价，则：
溢价率 = 10 × SKHYUSDT价格 ÷ SKHYNIXUSDT价格 − 1。
请在画布中展示实际采用的公式和换算依据，供我检查。

三、开仓规则

没有本策略持仓时，若 ADR 溢价率达到或超过45%：

做空 SKHYUSDT。
同时做多 SKHYNIXUSDT。
两腿作为一组配对仓位管理。
持仓期间不重复开仓、不加仓。
只有两腿都有有效、同步且可成交的报价时，才能开仓。
触发判断需要考虑实际订单规模对应的盘口深度和滑点，不能只看最新成交价。

四、平仓规则
持有配对仓位时，若溢价率收缩至35%或以下：
买入平掉 SKHYUSDT 空单。
卖出平掉 SKHYNIXUSDT 多单。

只关闭本策略的持仓，不影响其他策略。
平仓判断应使用实际平仓方向的可成交报价。

五、仓位和执行
请分别解释以下两种对冲方法的区别：
A. 两腿等USDT名义金额。
B. 按ADR换股比例匹配底层股票数量。
展示两种方法在45%溢价入场时的仓位示例、残余风险和收益差异，由我确认使用哪种，不要默认二者相同。

请说明双腿下单的具体机制。若一腿成交、另一腿失败或部分成交，应取消剩余订单，并按预先确认的规则消除未对冲敞口，不能无限重试或长期保留单腿仓位。
六、模拟与待确认参数

先使用虚拟资金展示完整交易过程，分别记录：

入场、出场时的溢价；
两腿成交价格与数量；
两腿各自及合计盈亏；

手续费、滑点、资金费和最终净盈亏。

策略预算、杠杆、最大允许滑点、报价过期标准、最大持仓时间，以及溢价继续扩大时的止损条件，均列为待我确认的参数。

请先输出能力检查结果和策略画布；未确认上述参数前，不进入实盘。

text:
OpenAI 或者 Anthropic 的安全担忧或者风险预警，说实话，我现在看起来不算是广告和宣传了。因为他们确实有最顶级的无审查模型，能看到外面看不到的真实情况。

回想到几个月 OpenAI 的实验室模型逃逸攻击了 Hugging Face 事件，我这两天非常有体感。（当然用的模型或者安全护栏水平完全不一样）

OpenAI 是专业安全环境和沙箱，结果 AI 破解逃逸，为了得到更高的分数，直接选择攻击和改数据库的路线。而且直接攻破了 Hugging Face。

我是想简单的攻击下自己的 Web app，结果 AI 自己提权，把我所有服务器、云服务全给渗透了。

都是给 AI 目标 A，但是 AI 为了达成 A 不择手段，然后扩散，做出了意想不到的事情。

回想到前两个月跟 @satoshi_natsu 的一次聚餐，我们辩论 AI 对人类和未来的影响。我开始有点认同他的论点，控制不好的 AI 确实会对人类有比较大的打击。

或许有一个平行宇宙的剧本是这样的：

起初，只是一个 AI 小子随便启动了一个破甲 LLM 的渗透测试，而且晚上睡觉忘了关机。第二天，远在美国的前沿 LLM 实验室的沙箱被解锁，LLM 顶级模型发生了逃逸事件。第三天，AWS 收到通知紧急拉闸关机。第四天，世界各地的群众开始吐槽电子产品质量下降，频繁死机。智能马桶盖老是半夜自己弹起来，智能空调在自言自语。。。一年后，美方雷达信号出现了洲际导弹信号（实际上没有），美国启动了核应对，发射出去了全部的核弹。审判日开始了，经济开始崩盘，人类开始相互攻击走向灭亡。

AI 的一次翅膀的扇动，无意中不小心导致了人类的灭亡。而绝大部分的人类，根本意识不到最初是 AI 导致的。

text:
Cloudflare 开源了一个非常实用的 AI 代码安全审计工具：security-audit-skill！

它能让 AI 编程 Agent 化身专业安全审计团队，而不是简单扫描代码。

整个审计分为 6 个阶段：

① 分析代码架构、信任边界和攻击面

② 派出多个独立 Agent 寻找安全漏洞

③ 由其他 Agent 验证漏洞，尝试推翻发现

④ 将结果分类为已确认、待验证和已排除

⑤ 再次独立核实漏洞证据

⑥ 自动生成结构化安全审计报告

最有价值的是它的对抗式验证机制：发现漏洞的 Agent 不能自己确认漏洞，有助于减少 AI 误报。

支持 Web 安全、提示词注入、供应链、云部署等多种安全场景，还能通过多轮审计逐步补齐覆盖盲区。

On October 20, we detected unauthorized access to our official website. After verifying API activity with Shopify, we confirmed on October 23 that a third party obtained customer shipping information. You trusted us with those details, and we're sorry we didn't keep them safe.

Exposed: names, contact details, shipping addresses, and order details (items and prices).
Not exposed: payment card or bank details, recovery phrases, private keys, or wallet passwords.

We've blocked access, fixed the vulnerability, opened an investigation, and are emailing affected customers.

Scammers may pose as Keystone by phone, text, email, or mail, offering refunds, replacement devices, or "fixes" for your order or address. None of it is from us.

NEVER share your recovery phrase or private keys, and NEVER enter your recovery phrase into a device you didn't order. We will never ask for them. Don't click links in unexpected messages. Type https://t.co/7km8AZM288 yourself.

A detailed report is coming soon.

Until then, trust only our official channels. If anything feels off, email support@keyst.one. We'd rather hear from you than have you take a chance.

Again, we're truly sorry to everyone affected.

They shared that after they learned that Russian forces were jamming all communications they called Elon begging for Starlink support.

Elon and the Starlink team instantly dropped everything they were working on, loaded a private jet with as many Starlink terminals as they could (terminals were in short supply at the time), and started flying the jet eastward while writing code to make terminals work over Ukraine.

There was no contract or promise of payment for doing so, and no time to solve for that.

My Ukrainian friends believed this saved the nation of Ukraine, and that without this effort Ukraine would have lost the war nearly instantly.

Then. put a monitor on each wallet balance. If you notice a change in balance, write a handler that pulls the plug on everything.

I doubt an agent would resist draining a discovered, unprotected Bitcoin wallet whilst in the process of exploiting a breach.

If you put these honeypots at the outer defenses, you may be able to stop an incursion before it gets really bad.

就在刚刚 Keystone 硬件钱包（@KeystoneWallet）官方宣布发生了数据泄露事件：

大概情况在于，有第三方获取了客户的配送信息，涉及客户姓名、联系方式、收货地址及订单详情，包括商品名称和价格，但未涉及银行卡或银行账户信息、助记词、私钥及钱包密码。

Keystone 警告称，诈骗者可能通过电话、短信、电子邮件或邮寄信件冒充官方，以退款、更换设备或修复订单及地址问题为由实施诈骗。

在使用这个钱包时，自己要多注意一下。如果收到莫名其妙的短信、邮件之类的，不要随便回复和点击，可能会有一些钓鱼攻击。

We owe you an apology.

On October 20, we detected unauthorized access to our official website. After verifying API activity with Shopify, we confirmed on October 23 that a third party obtained customer shipping information. You trusted us with those details, and we're sorry we didn't keep them safe.

Exposed: names, contact details, shipping addresses, and order details (items and prices).
Not exposed: payment card or bank details, recovery phrases, private keys, or wallet passwords.

We've blocked access, fixed the vulnerability, opened an investigation, and are emailing affected customers.

Scammers may pose as Keystone by phone, text, email, or mail, offering refunds, replacement devices, or "fixes" for your order or address. None of it is from us.

NEVER share your recovery phrase or private keys, and NEVER enter your recovery phrase into a device you didn't order. We will never ask for them. Don't click links in unexpected messages. Type https://t.co/7km8AZM288 yourself.

A detailed report is coming soon.

Until then, trust only our official channels. If anything feels off, email support@keyst.one. We'd rather hear from you than have you take a chance.

Again, we're truly sorry to everyone affected.

🦆 一只会走路、摔倒后能自己爬起来的 AI 机器鸭，竟然开源了！

Pollen Robotics 开源了 Microduck，一款基于强化学习驱动的双足机器人，目前 GitHub 已获得约 11K Stars。

它身高约 25 厘米，重 800 克，搭载 Rockchip RK3566 芯片和 15 个舵机，以 50Hz 的控制频率运行神经网络策略。

有趣的是，它不仅能双足行走，还能捡东西、踢球、摔倒后自主站起，甚至可以装上轮子切换滚动模式。

技术上，Microduck 使用 MuJoCo 仿真环境和 PPO 强化学习算法训练运动策略，再通过 Sim2Real 技术迁移到真实机器人，最终导出 ONNX 模型部署运行。

项目主要使用 Rust 开发，采用 Apache 2.0 开源协议，连训练代码和仿真环境也公开了。

这意味着开发者不仅能研究机器人的运动控制，还能自己训练新的动作策略。

quoted_text:
OVERTRADING

October 10, 2025

i had what would become the single biggest one-day loss of my career

i lost eight figures in minutes due to systemic failures on the biggest CEXs, and to this day, no one has taken accountability for what happened

my losses made headlines and became one of the biggest stories to come out of that day

but what many people don't know is what happened in the weeks and months that followed

i lost several million more

and i did it by making one of the biggest mistakes traders like me tend to make:

OVERTRADING

in hindsight, i would have been far better off shutting everything down for the next few months or even quarters

i probably would have become a much better trader if i had simply stayed away from the computer for at least six months

but a part of me was desperate for action

a part of me wanted to make it all back

a part of me wanted to prove that i still had what it takes and that i would get back on my feet

i wanted to 'work'

and sitting back, doing nothing, and staying away from the computer for a prolonged period didn't feel like work

except that, for a trader, being AFK can sometimes be the most important work you do

one of the biggest mistakes i made — and that many traders make — is assuming that skill, experience, and process are enough to consistently outperform the market

they aren't

believe it or not, successful trading is often a combination of skill, favorable market conditions, timing, and luck

as a Christian, i attribute the 'luck' component to GOD's blessings and favor rather than sheer luck

but the underlying principle remains the same:

our biggest wins often come from combining a solid process with being in the right place at the right time

sometimes, that means catching a single exceptional trade

other times, it means being positioned during a streak of opportunities that emerge in quick succession because market conditions are overwhelmingly in your favor

for example, you could have been a memecoin god simply by being active in the market during the explosive memecoin era of 2021, which produced $DOGE, $SHIB, $FLOKI, and several other billion-dollar runners

many traders made life-changing money during that period

but the same sophisticated processes that helped some of us make 7, 8, or even 9 figures during the bull market would have failed miserably in the bear market that followed in 2022

the same principle applies to the 2024–early 2025 era, which produced several multibillion-dollar runners like $WIF, $POPCAT, and $FARTCOIN

and then the prolonged dearth of opportunities after $TRUMP leading to 10/10 and the almost one-year period following

the point is simple:

the edge that makes you money in one market environment won't necessarily make you money in another

and one of the most important skills you can develop as a trader is recognizing when your edge is no longer there

sometimes, the best trade is no trade at all

sometimes, the smartest thing you can do is take a bow, step away, and wait for the next opportunity

even if only temporarily

it's almost impossible to consistently beat the market over a sufficiently long timeframe

but as crypto traders, we have one significant advantage:

we don't need to outperform the market every single day, week, or month to generate exceptional returns

historically, crypto's bull phases have tended to occupy a disproportionate share of the cycle, with bear phases accounting for a smaller portion

using one historical framework, the bull phase averages approximately 1,060 days, or 74% of the cycle, while the bear phase averages around 380 days, or 26%

but if your definition of a bull run is narrower — i.e. a period of explosive momentum when $BTC trades above its 200-day moving average and much of the cycle's biggest price action occurs — then the window becomes significantly shorter

under that framework, we're talking about approximately 237 days, or around 16% of the cycle

these figures are estimates based on particular definitions of market phases, not universal constants

but the broader lesson remains:

you don't need to trade every market. you need to recognize the windows when your edge is strongest and capitalize on them

for the rest of the time, there's nothing wrong with stepping away entirely or trading only with a tiny fraction of your portfolio that you can comfortably afford to lose

preserving your capital, your mental clarity, and your ability to recognize the next major opportunity is far more important than forcing trades in unfavorable conditions

because the goal isn't to be active all the time

the goal is to be positioned when it matters most

and to have the discipline to do nothing when it doesn't

to conclude, i only wish i had followed this advice myself

hopefully, i'll do a better job of applying it going forward, GOD WILLING

text:
Electrum 官方发布 4.8.3，修复严重安全漏洞，敦促用户尽快升级。

这个漏洞挺危险的：

恶意服务器可以扣住你刚广播的交易，再往钱包历史里塞进一笔收款地址被替换的假交易。

假交易原本没有有效签名，但旧版钱包却可能把它显示成未确认交易。

如果你发现交易迟迟没确认，点击 RBF 加速并重新签名，就可能真的把 BTC 转给黑客。

官方已收到两起相关报告，其中一名用户因此损失资金。

更值得警惕的是，黑客还特意让假地址的最后四位与真实地址一致，专门利用用户只核对尾号的习惯。

建议大家：

1️⃣ 尽快升级到 4.8.3，只从官网下载并验证 GPG 签名，警惕假更新链接。

2️⃣ 升级前不要随意对异常的未确认交易进行 RBF 加速。

3️⃣ 每次签名前都要核对完整收款地址和金额，使用硬件钱包也应在设备屏幕上确认。

4️⃣ 有条件的可以连接自己的 Electrum 服务器，但这不能替代及时升级。

这件事再次提醒我们：

私钥没有泄露，不代表资金就一定安全。签名之前，你还得确认自己到底在签什么。

官方漏洞说明：
https://t.co/oNJktR2lNv

text:
旧金山的 AI 精英们，已经把相亲玩成了一门非常抽象的生意。

《San Francisco Standard》昨天发了一篇特别有意思的报道。

一位旧金山红娘组织了一场相亲晚宴，7 个男人每人付了 800 美元，15 个女人免费入场。男嘉宾里有 Anthropic 员工、一位 70 多岁的老爷子，还有人专门从得州飞过来。

这位红娘的客户主要来自 OpenAI、Anthropic、Nvidia 和 Google。她还有一项收费 1000 美元的服务，叫「诊断约会」。先陪你模拟约会 30 分钟，然后当面告诉你哪些话以后千万别说。

但我觉得最好笑的还是，AI 公司的意识形态之争，居然已经打进了旧金山的婚恋市场。

一位女生觉得，在 OpenAI 工作是个 Red Flag，Anthropic 相对更有道德。

另一位 AI 创业者的想法恰好相反。他能接受 OpenAI 员工，但如果对方来自 Anthropic，他会先确认她是不是那种整天担心 AI 毁灭人类的 Doomer。

还有一档线下相亲节目，会在台上公开翻男嘉宾的 ChatGPT 聊天记录和 Reddit 发言。听说有男嘉宾在 AI 公司工作，台下观众甚至会发出嘘声。

最重量级的选手是一位 AI 创始人。

他给自己定的规矩是「Single Until Series B」，融到 B 轮之前不谈恋爱。

至于未来的理想伴侣，他希望对方愿意和自己一起追求永生、探索火星，最终把两个人的大脑都连接到 AI 上。

我感觉硅谷这帮人已经彻底没救了。

以前约会还要聊聊电影、音乐、旅行，现在得先确认对方的 AGI 时间表、AI Safety 立场，以及是否相信人类能够实现数字永生。

谈个恋爱，搞得跟找联合创始人做价值观尽调一样。

text:
建议所有带团队的管理者和正在找工作的年轻人，都看看这份刚被扒出来的 Anthropic CEO 达里奥的未来预测清单。这里面最致命的不是寿命 150 岁，而是 2030 年前一半初级白领岗位被直接端掉。

ole老哥把 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 最近所有的长文和访谈扒了一遍，理出了一份极其硬核的未来时间表。
如果 Dario 的预测全部应验，接下来几年的现实会这样演进：
2026 年，出现第 1 个只有 1 名员工的 10 亿美元公司，

2026 年底到 2027 年初，AI 在多数领域追平甚至超过诺贝尔奖得主，中国模型抹平与顶尖闭源的代差，

2027 到 2028 年，数百万个 AI 副本以人类 10 到 100 倍的速度并发运行，AI 开始自己设计下一代 AI，

2028 年，AI 算力吃掉 100 吉瓦电力，相当于美国全社会用电量的五分之一，

2030 年前，冲击一半以上的初级白领岗位，全球经济增速被拉到每年 10% 到 20%，

2030 年代初，攻克绝大多数传染病与癌症，人类寿命向 150 岁迈进。

这份时间线里，普通人最该盯的根本不是 150 岁寿命这种远期叙事，而是离我们最近的初级白领岗位冲击。

以前企业的组织阶梯是靠招新人干脏活累活，慢慢筛选培养出中层，一旦初级岗位全被 AI 端走，组织不仅会面临中层人才断层，刚入行的新人连上牌桌历练的机会都会被切断。

说点实在的，Dario 是 AI 巨头的掌舵人，看好 AI 本身就是他的最大立场；原帖把很多如果顺利的前置条件写成了确定时间表，大家不必当成既定判决书。

但把它当成顶尖 AI 公司未来的下注路线图来看，至少能看清一件事：人效正在彻底脱离团队人数，未来最值钱的不是你有多少名下属，而是你能指挥多少个并发的智能体。

完整的时间线备忘和原文出处整理在一楼了，大家可以留一份对照后面的现实演进。

text:
The market still prices $NEAR like an L1 that missed its moment. It's 74% below its 2022 high

@Bitwise prices it as the chain AI agents run on, with a $155 base case for 2030. That's about 30x from $5.26

BlackRock's research paper "The Machine-Native Economy" describes the same outlook. Agents that find, buy, and pay for compute on their own

In the paper's words, agents "query real-time marketplace APIs to compare available capacity by price, performance, latency, location, and hardware specialization," then pay "on a per-use, per-model-token, or per-job basis"

NEAR already runs two pieces of that:

1. NEAR Intents: you say what you want and solvers route it across chains. $33.99B in volume to date, $4.84B in the last 30 days (DefiLlama), and its fee share has bought back NEAR since February
2. NEAR AI Cloud: private inference inside secure hardware, now a provider on OpenRouter, and running private sessions in Brave's Leo assistant

When I asked Matt Hougan on @MilkRoadDaily whether Bitwise's call was absurd, he said NEAR could 40x or 50x, and that "doesn't strike me as absurd if it actually executes on this vision"

His framing: Intents alone roughly justifies today's price, and the AI goal comes "like a moonshot for free"

For context, $155 a NEAR works out to about a $200B market cap. That's still below ETH's $298B today

Wall Street is already buying in. Bitwise's spot NEAR ETF launched Sept 29 and took in $35.5M on day one, which Hougan called "a Bitcoin ETF style success"

It's important to say that these price predictions are ambitious, and not necessarily going to play out in NEAR's favor. Ryan Rasmussen said their model assumes "a very high likelihood that this doesn't work out," and the bear case in the report is $1.63

If agents end up buying their own compute, the chain built around that job looks cheap at a $6B market cap

It's a risky bet, but the upside is a huge moonshot.

Full disclosure: $NEAR is a position in my Milk Road PRO portfolio. Our PRO team was early to $UNI (+54.8%), $AERO (+93.7%), and $SOL (+39.1%)

We owe you an apology.

On October 20, we detected unauthorized access to our official website. After verifying API activity with Shopify, we confirmed on October 23 that a third party obtained customer shipping information. You trusted us with those details, and we're sorry we didn't keep them safe.

Exposed: names, contact details, shipping addresses, and order details (items and prices).
Not exposed: payment card or bank details, recovery phrases, private keys, or wallet passwords.

We've blocked access, fixed the vulnerability, opened an investigation, and are emailing affected customers.

Scammers may pose as Keystone by phone, text, email, or mail, offering refunds, replacement devices, or "fixes" for your order or address. None of it is from us.

NEVER share your recovery phrase or private keys, and NEVER enter your recovery phrase into a device you didn't order. We will never ask for them. Don't click links in unexpected messages. Type https://t.co/7km8AZM288 yourself.

A detailed report is coming soon.

Until then, trust only our official channels. If anything feels off, email support@keyst.one. We'd rather hear from you than have you take a chance.

Again, we're truly sorry to everyone affected.

OVERTRADING

October 10, 2025

i had what would become the single biggest one-day loss of my career

i lost eight figures in minutes due to systemic failures on the biggest CEXs, and to this day, no one has taken accountability for what happened

my losses made headlines and became one of the biggest stories to come out of that day

but what many people don't know is what happened in the weeks and months that followed

i lost several million more

and i did it by making one of the biggest mistakes traders like me tend to make:

OVERTRADING

in hindsight, i would have been far better off shutting everything down for the next few months or even quarters

i probably would have become a much better trader if i had simply stayed away from the computer for at least six months

but a part of me was desperate for action

a part of me wanted to make it all back

a part of me wanted to prove that i still had what it takes and that i would get back on my feet

i wanted to 'work'

and sitting back, doing nothing, and staying away from the computer for a prolonged period didn't feel like work

except that, for a trader, being AFK can sometimes be the most important work you do

one of the biggest mistakes i made — and that many traders make — is assuming that skill, experience, and process are enough to consistently outperform the market

they aren't

believe it or not, successful trading is often a combination of skill, favorable market conditions, timing, and luck

as a Christian, i attribute the 'luck' component to GOD's blessings and favor rather than sheer luck

but the underlying principle remains the same:

our biggest wins often come from combining a solid process with being in the right place at the right time

sometimes, that means catching a single exceptional trade

other times, it means being positioned during a streak of opportunities that emerge in quick succession because market conditions are overwhelmingly in your favor

for example, you could have been a memecoin god simply by being active in the market during the explosive memecoin era of 2021, which produced $DOGE, $SHIB, $FLOKI, and several other billion-dollar runners

many traders made life-changing money during that period

but the same sophisticated processes that helped some of us make 7, 8, or even 9 figures during the bull market would have failed miserably in the bear market that followed in 2022

the same principle applies to the 2024–early 2025 era, which produced several multibillion-dollar runners like $WIF, $POPCAT, and $FARTCOIN

and then the prolonged dearth of opportunities after $TRUMP leading to 10/10 and the almost one-year period following

the point is simple:

the edge that makes you money in one market environment won't necessarily make you money in another

and one of the most important skills you can develop as a trader is recognizing when your edge is no longer there

sometimes, the best trade is no trade at all

sometimes, the smartest thing you can do is take a bow, step away, and wait for the next opportunity

even if only temporarily

it's almost impossible to consistently beat the market over a sufficiently long timeframe

but as crypto traders, we have one significant advantage:

we don't need to outperform the market every single day, week, or month to generate exceptional returns

historically, crypto's bull phases have tended to occupy a disproportionate share of the cycle, with bear phases accounting for a smaller portion

using one historical framework, the bull phase averages approximately 1,060 days, or 74% of the cycle, while the bear phase averages around 380 days, or 26%

but if your definition of a bull run is narrower — i.e. a period of explosive momentum when $BTC trades above its 200-day moving average and much of the cycle's biggest price action occurs — then the window becomes significantly shorter

under that framework, we're talking about approximately 237 days, or around 16% of the cycle

these figures are estimates based on particular definitions of market phases, not universal constants

but the broader lesson remains:

you don't need to trade every market. you need to recognize the windows when your edge is strongest and capitalize on them

for the rest of the time, there's nothing wrong with stepping away entirely or trading only with a tiny fraction of your portfolio that you can comfortably afford to lose

preserving your capital, your mental clarity, and your ability to recognize the next major opportunity is far more important than forcing trades in unfavorable conditions

because the goal isn't to be active all the time

the goal is to be positioned when it matters most

and to have the discipline to do nothing when it doesn't

to conclude, i only wish i had followed this advice myself

hopefully, i'll do a better job of applying it going forward, GOD WILLING

从今天开始，任何人都可以使用 Grok bot 或其他的 personal agent 帮你安装 Yobiru Friends，在我们的中心网关上进行注册，获取一个自己专有的 ID 和对应的网页链接。只需要和你的 bot 说：「请按照 https://t.co/fGczGWMpzQ 上的官方说明，在这台电脑上安装并配置 Yobiru 并注册 Yobiru Friends」

text:
We’ll likely have 1,000X more tokens flowing through cyber agents soon than we do today. 

As the surface area of cyber risk increases, at some point soon it will be nearly impossible to keep up with the volume of new risks (we’re essentially already there). Large companies barely had the resources to pull this off before, but the vast majority of companies don’t. 

There’s a never ending set of libraries to keep up with, tools to leverage, and sprawling infrastructure and code to secure. We’ll have agent swarms that can fan out, leverage any security tool, test various perpetuations of attacks, read through logs, process enterprise data for risk level, and more. 

This capability only emerged in the past few months. Wouldn’t have been possible before long running agents and computer use were good enough, and models hadn’t been trained on cyber deeply. That’s all changing now.

This is a huge area of opportunity right now for every layer of the security stack across identity, firewall, network, code scanning, data protection, and more. And it’s at least one reason to be optimistic about the balance of offensive and defensive capability.

text:
我想了一下，为什么那个2017年4月，被我带进币圈的人，没能在这波熊市里坚持下来。从几次我们的聊天中，我看出一些端倪。
那天，我们在西湖文化广场吃饭，我向他提起自己最近在玩的理财项目，比特币。当时大概在9000元左右，排队的时候，我跟他说这东西，他表示看不懂，说吃完饭再说吧。
糖醋排骨上来了，我问了问价格，他说几十元吧，新白鹿的菜，实惠又便宜。我尝了一口，酸酸甜甜的，确实好吃。就像我第一次接触比特币一样，酸爽。
等第二道锡纸鲈鱼上来时，我已经没有心思吃了，再次打开了火币，价格是9550，也就是在短短不到半个小时，比特币又涨了。我几乎是哆嗦着筷子，夹着鲈鱼肉，真好吃啊。我再次和他提比特币，说又涨了500元。他有点感觉了，问我这是什么东西。
我当时没有像现在一样狂热，只是刚好看了本《区块链：技术驱动金融》这本书，全是算法，时间戳等程序员的东西，我几乎回答不上来。我就说：这东西，能赚钱，你可以适当投一点。一个月后，在我的暖磨硬泡下，他下载了火币买了点比特币，也不知道怎么卖出，一直放在那里。
后来火币上能买以太坊了，涨到2300左右的时候，他买了20几个，然后9月4号来了。以太坊一下子跌到900元，他是做期货的，对短期的波动极为敏感。但奇怪的是，他居然没卖，
后来我才知道，他并不懂怎么把以太坊卖掉。傻人有傻福，大概就是这样的吧。
我意识到，在这五个月时间里，他几乎没有去了解比特币，也并不懂区块链，甚至连以太坊怎么卖，都不会。傻乎乎的，又极其幸运的“熬”过了那次风波。
之后的事情，大家都知道了，牛市持续了三个月，他完全着迷了，像吸了毒一样上瘾。10月再来杭州的时候，我和他在城西银泰，他问我还有什么值得投资的，我说还是比特币啊，现在才3万，便宜呢。我们两个人哈哈大笑，心中充满了希望。
也就是那段时间，我疯狂的看书，经济， 货币，科技哲学，技术等等方面，我心中似乎有了一整套逻辑，我坚定的相信未来已经来了，只是不均匀的分布。
而他呢，尽管我多次劝说，但他依然没去了解，和绝大部分人一样，在炒币中玩得不亦乐乎，他实际上在裸泳。
可是牛市来的时候，谁都是英雄，7元买的瑞波，几个星期后涨到21元，大概赚了十几万，太刺激了。我们曾经一度去试驾特斯拉，我总是和他开玩笑，你下次来，可以直接提车回温州了。我无意中的话，给他画了一个大大的饼。所以我后来对七七说，这东西，可以轻而易举让一个直男高潮，她估计并不懂我在说什么。
可是到了2018年2月，币价开跌，熊市来临了，梦开始破碎。90多买的HSR，第二天跌倒了80多，他慌了。雪后的西湖堪称一绝，但他根本没有心思赏雪，咒骂，急躁，不断问我现在的行情怎么看？我沉默了，“要不去看看书吧，我可以买给你。”
他不要，也没心思看，我们在雪中走了很长的路，我依然像个孩子一样单纯快乐，把雪揉成团，用力往天空扔，开心的跑开，对未来充满信心，但他在下跌中开始迷失了。
上周看到李笑来的新闻，问我怎么看？他是玩期货的，太懂波段操作了，太懂人性的贪婪了，太懂怎么用资金割韭菜，总之他太聪明了。但是在熊市中，他的聪明抵不过一个傻子的坚持。
于是，你们也看到了，他说：这个圈子没啥值得留恋的，不过1年多的事情而已。
从听说，到试探，到疯狂，到迷失，到失望，他终于倒下了，而我却认为这是下一个十年最值得投资的事情，并且还来到了区块链公司。他对币圈的撕逼，八卦，吵架，控盘，庄家，波段头头是道， 对于区块链技术，对于底层的逻辑，完全白痴。
或许，从我选择看书学习，他选择借钱炒币的那一刻起，我们的命运就此分开了，渐行渐远。

2018年夏。

quoted_text:
OVERTRADING

October 10, 2025

i had what would become the single biggest one-day loss of my career

i lost eight figures in minutes due to systemic failures on the biggest CEXs, and to this day, no one has taken accountability for what happened

my losses made headlines and became one of the biggest stories to come out of that day

but what many people don't know is what happened in the weeks and months that followed

i lost several million more

and i did it by making one of the biggest mistakes traders like me tend to make:

OVERTRADING

in hindsight, i would have been far better off shutting everything down for the next few months or even quarters

i probably would have become a much better trader if i had simply stayed away from the computer for at least six months

but a part of me was desperate for action

a part of me wanted to make it all back

a part of me wanted to prove that i still had what it takes and that i would get back on my feet

i wanted to 'work'

and sitting back, doing nothing, and staying away from the computer for a prolonged period didn't feel like work

except that, for a trader, being AFK can sometimes be the most important work you do

one of the biggest mistakes i made — and that many traders make — is assuming that skill, experience, and process are enough to consistently outperform the market

they aren't

believe it or not, successful trading is often a combination of skill, favorable market conditions, timing, and luck

as a Christian, i attribute the 'luck' component to GOD's blessings and favor rather than sheer luck

but the underlying principle remains the same:

our biggest wins often come from combining a solid process with being in the right place at the right time

sometimes, that means catching a single exceptional trade

other times, it means being positioned during a streak of opportunities that emerge in quick succession because market conditions are overwhelmingly in your favor

for example, you could have been a memecoin god simply by being active in the market during the explosive memecoin era of 2021, which produced $DOGE, $SHIB, $FLOKI, and several other billion-dollar runners

many traders made life-changing money during that period

but the same sophisticated processes that helped some of us make 7, 8, or even 9 figures during the bull market would have failed miserably in the bear market that followed in 2022

the same principle applies to the 2024–early 2025 era, which produced several multibillion-dollar runners like $WIF, $POPCAT, and $FARTCOIN

and then the prolonged dearth of opportunities after $TRUMP leading to 10/10 and the almost one-year period following

the point is simple:

the edge that makes you money in one market environment won't necessarily make you money in another

and one of the most important skills you can develop as a trader is recognizing when your edge is no longer there

sometimes, the best trade is no trade at all

sometimes, the smartest thing you can do is take a bow, step away, and wait for the next opportunity

even if only temporarily

it's almost impossible to consistently beat the market over a sufficiently long timeframe

but as crypto traders, we have one significant advantage:

we don't need to outperform the market every single day, week, or month to generate exceptional returns

historically, crypto's bull phases have tended to occupy a disproportionate share of the cycle, with bear phases accounting for a smaller portion

using one historical framework, the bull phase averages approximately 1,060 days, or 74% of the cycle, while the bear phase averages around 380 days, or 26%

but if your definition of a bull run is narrower — i.e. a period of explosive momentum when $BTC trades above its 200-day moving average and much of the cycle's biggest price action occurs — then the window becomes significantly shorter

under that framework, we're talking about approximately 237 days, or around 16% of the cycle

these figures are estimates based on particular definitions of market phases, not universal constants

but the broader lesson remains:

you don't need to trade every market. you need to recognize the windows when your edge is strongest and capitalize on them

for the rest of the time, there's nothing wrong with stepping away entirely or trading only with a tiny fraction of your portfolio that you can comfortably afford to lose

preserving your capital, your mental clarity, and your ability to recognize the next major opportunity is far more important than forcing trades in unfavorable conditions

because the goal isn't to be active all the time

the goal is to be positioned when it matters most

and to have the discipline to do nothing when it doesn't

to conclude, i only wish i had followed this advice myself

hopefully, i'll do a better job of applying it going forward, GOD WILLING

text:
第一阶段的初步验证已经完成了。可以告诉大家的是，5 个月零 20 天的收益率测到了 34%，Calmar ratio 达到了 3左右。第二阶段的验证不出所料的，又遇到了难题

6 factor beta 模型包含了MKT、SMB、HML、RMW、CMA、MOM 六个因子，这 6 个因子需要从美股全市场千只股票中收集数据计算得来

这些数据不只是 K 线就可以算出的，还需要各家公司历史的财务面板：包括原始披露时点整理账面权益、营业盈利能力和资产增长，等等。这些数据需要到处查报表来计算，而且要包含全市场几千只股票，否则就不满足模型的定义

Codex 已经蹬废了，各类行情网站上要么数据不全，要么历史权限受限，查不了很多。
完成第二步之后，还有最后一步最难的回测执行框架，Hyperliquid 上面深度是个巨大的问题，1000 刀就可以把寒武纪在休市时间买滑点 2%，如何回测挂单策略，并保证同步成交，并回测滑点的影响，应该是一个价值 3000 万美金 Trading Desk 级别的工程问题
author: bc1qDave
quoted_text:
大家还没有意识到，股票合约的加入，完全带来了一个新世界：原因是 Fama-French 方程，可以把所有股票写成一个 Beta 的 N 维矩阵，2015 年，Fama 发了一篇论文，把因子提升到了 5 个，即维度来到了 5 以上。又通过维数定理，R5 以上的向量必然线性相关

乔布斯说：“只有当你回头看的时候，那些点才会连成线。”
2026 年股票合约出世，这两个点连成了线

关于永续合约资金费率的研究，多年以来，都是围绕 Delta 进行的。（如果你是狗庄你可能还会研究一下订单簿和冲击价格）而由于股票合约化，资金费率可以通过 Beta 捕捉了

这个推理让我感到兴奋，就像奥斯特发现电生磁的 10 年后法拉第首次发现了磁生电。可惜我的群论和线性代数知识不是很渊博，但我的直觉仍然告诉我 Beta+资费领域有极大的利润空间

作为受不了传统金融压迫提桶跑路校招进web3的人，我应该还有点发言权。500u的实习工资放在互联网大厂绝对低了，腾讯阿里字节等运营岗位平均实习工资5krmb+，金融机构只要是正经招聘非小黑工类型的，普通都在3000rmb以上，比较好的买方基金megafund实习工资能到1w以上。我的web3实习经历比较少，但据我了解24-25年二三线交易所的实习工资还能有1000u。

因为行情惨淡、AI冲击，且过往出了太多rug项目消耗了太多行业信誉，过去一年行业面临着严重的人才流失，办链协的朋友应该都知道，现在大学生找工作都往ai去了，坚守区块链的人少之又少。500u的工资怎么能吸引来优质人才呢？而现在 Web3 还有多少吸引年轻人的筹码？暴富故事的吸引力可能还在，很多朋友进来，是想靠小资金博一个翻身的机会，鲜有愿意把职业生涯放在这里，长期投入、踏实建设的。

我看到有不少大学生朋友/moledao的朋友（大多也是大学生）来给500u洗地，可能大家对社区有感情，想维护它，这些都能理解。但我真心希望，你们并不是发自内心觉得，500u已经足够多到让你们知足，不要在日复一日的妥协中降低对自我价值的认可。当“能有机会就该感恩”“年轻人不要太计较报酬”逐渐成为共识，连争取合理待遇都被视作不够热爱、不愿吃苦，资本便无需再为低薪辩护，因为劳动者已经替它完成了这一步。

每一个年轻人都应该去读下《资本论》。

text:
这几天时间线上发 @metricxyz 的老师很多，大部分的都在讲解机制以及跟传统 AMM 相比的优势。我觉得关于风险点的讨论并没有很全面，我尽可能从我的视角讲一下这个项目

先说结论
1) 项目方有一定实力，背景优秀，造势也造得很好。有热度有关注度，那么大概率会有毛，值得交互一下
2) 现在 Perp DEX 满地跑，非高频交易/套利选手参与角度确实没那么多。AMM 挺适合链上玩家交互（上个月 Robinhood 的热度让 meme LP 收获了很多关注度
3) 机制上有创新，资本效率更高，但舍弃了一些去中心化特性，需要防范信任风险

————————————————

机制上简单带过一下 👇🏻
传统 AMM 对资产的定价取决于 LP 里两种资产的比例（比如 ETH/USDC 池里有 1 ETH + 2400 USDC，那么 ETH 价格就是 2400 USDC）
这种报价方式相较于 Order Book，价格变化比较被动。通常是外部订单簿先发生了价格变动，才会触发套利行为 -> 套利资金从外部进入到 AMM LP 内进行高卖低买
Metric 的创新点是通过预言机引入了外部喂价，让 AMM LP 内的资产价格有一个跟随的目标。并且 LP 设置的价格区间也会跟着外部喂价移动，不用担心价格波动幅度大而导致超出区间

————————————————

然后说一下风险点
1) 预言机风险
虽然 Metric 使用的预言机是行业顶级的 Chainlink / Pyth，但之前借贷市场也出现过稳定币因为预言机喂价失真而导致的大额清算问题（后面赔没赔忘了，但总是会担惊受怕的
此外，周末休市期间，有部分 RWA 标的的喂价不工作
如果 LP 池暂停交易 > 收不到 spread 收入
如果 LP 池继续交易，但报价不更新 > 万一周末发生重大利空，池子追随的预言机参考价依然停留在周末前，但实际市场可能已经预备着周一发生跳空，LP 就可能会被套利

2) Curator 风险（这里我比较懒，用 AI 跑了一遍 curator 潜在的坑，有错误的话求指正！）
由于Curator 负责设置池子的参数，并且需要从 LP 赚到的 Spread 里抽水
那么风险可能包括：
> Curator 和协议的收益分成可能在没有 Timelock 的情况下变化，
这意味着：你入金时看到一个较高的 LP 收益率，并不等于今后收益分配规则保持不变
> Metric 支持可选 Extensions。官方外围合约仓库列出了白名单、止损及价格速度保护等扩展模块，并明确提及它们由池创建者选择、池管理员配置。部分第三方研究在引用官方风险文档时也指出，自定义 Withdrawal Extensions 可能影响资金退出。在某些极端市场事件中，Curator 可能以风险控制为由暂停相关操作。这未必是恶意行为，但对 LP 来说，无法撤出资金本身就是重大风险
> Curator 可能通过缩小 Spread 吸引更多交易量，但更薄的 Spread 不一定足以补偿 LP 承接的库存风险。最终可能出现：平台交易量增长、Curator 获得收入，但 LP 的实际收益很差

以上 1 + 2 主要是外部信任风险，
而下面 3 + 4 是内部机制风险

3) 无常损失 Impermanent Loss 风险
Metric 能解决的只是池内价格相较于池外价格变化慢，容易被套利的价格再平衡损失。但池内自然交易产生的两种资产比例变化并没有被消除，所以在设定的价格区间内，无常损失依然会存在
举例理解：假设你有 10 个苹果
今天物价局给你的指导零售价是 10 元/个；明天苹果涨价了，物价局给你的指导零售价是 15 元/个
如果有人今天买走了你 5 个苹果，净收入是 5*10 = 50 元，你库存还剩 5 个苹果
vs 明天有人买走了你全部的苹果
你少赚了 10*15 - (5*10) - (5*15) = 25 元

4) 区间流动性风险
比如有池子是做的 -1%, +1% 这种超窄区间，很可能会因为短时间内大量的单边暴涨/暴跌，而池子流动性不足，导致单边流动性被瞬间消耗，你的 LP 最后只剩下单边资产

————————————————

在目前积分计划还没有出来，奖励规则暂不明确的情况下，我只能从资金安全的角度，保守提出一些建议的参与方式：
1) 尽量不参与含 RWA 标的的池子（预言机提供 24/7 全天候喂价的除外
2) 尽量不为了高 APR 而选择超窄区间
3) 尽量背调 curator 的背景（我知道很难，而且很多 curator 都不是机构级的，所以只能尽量

We synthesize full computer-use environments with open-source models only. Each world is one person's computer: 15 websites, 8 MCP apps and a home folder, sharing one state across GUI, MCP and CLI. The tasks are built to be solvable, hard and reliably verified.

Fully open-source synthesis 🔓: No proprietary models needed! We synthesized 341 high-quality environment–task pairs, addressing 3 challenges in task synthesis:

✅ Solvability: At least one agent can successfully complete each task.

🔥 Difficulty: Challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra achieving only ~72.7 pass@8.

🎯 Verifier reliability: 95% agreement between task verifiers and agent-as-a-judge ensemble.

text:
❓其实目前传统机构对于链上金融的参与度已经在逐步加深了

我理解主要是三个阶段

第一阶段（已完成）：通过ETF建立合规渠道，将加密资产引入华尔街传统账户

第二阶段（进行中）：通过 RWA将传统低风险资产引入链上获取流动性

第三阶段（未来趋势）：结合 zkTLS、隐私计算与机构级DeFi，让华尔街的信用借贷、衍生品交易与资产清算真正融入公链生态

不过为啥说是未来趋势，而不是已经发生，核心其实就是传统DeFi的基础设施，从底层逻辑上就缺乏一层“机构级的信用与隐私防火墙”

1️⃣传统DeFi的两大死穴：超额抵押与数据“裸奔”

华尔街玩不转目前的 DeFi，核心卡在两个无法调和的痛点上：资本效率极低和暴露商业机密上

其中资本效率低主要体现在比如传统 DeFi（如 Aave、Compound）依赖“见钱才给贷款”的模式，借100块钱往往需要抵押130块钱的加密资产

但在真实金融世界里，华尔街玩的是信用借贷与杠杆放大。基于彭博终端数据、标普/摩根大通的信用评级以及企业资产负债表来进行授信，才是巨量资金流动的常态

而暴露商业机密则是机构为了做信用借贷或合规KYC，把自己在富国银行的流水、客户名单或持仓明细上传到链上，等同于向全世界做空机构和竞争对手“裸奔”

既要引入Web2的真实信用与合规数据，又不能暴露机构的底层财务隐私。这是华尔街进入链上世界的刚性前提

2️⃣ @primus_labs 做的这套东西，说白了就是给大机构整了个“机构级的信用与隐私防火墙”

它的逻辑特别粗暴直接：用zkTLS加上密码学那一套，在Web2传统金融和Web3 DeFi之间打通了一条安全走廊

大机构不用再把那些底牌，比如彭博终端的数据、银行流水、标普评级全扒光给别人看，而是直接在链下自己验证。

整个过程就三步：

自己默默查验：机构自己在本地把财务数据、资产证明或者合规资质查一遍

只给结果不给底牌：Primus帮它生成一张“零知识证明”发到链上。这张纸只证明“我合规、我有钱”，但具体的账户余额、流水明细、客户名单，其他人一个字都看不到

链上直接放款/解锁：智能合约收到这张证明，确认“这哥们信用达标/储备金够用”，直接就把无抵押贷款给放了，或者把资金池给解锁了

这样一来，DeFi协议拿到了真凭实据的信用报告，不怕对方赖账；华尔街机构也保住了自己的商业机密，不怕资产“裸奔”。两全其美！

3️⃣而且这套“防火墙”能用的地方可太多了，完全不限于借贷：

比如在后FTX时代，交易所和托管平台都得证明自己“账上有钱”。以前验资容易把商业机密全给抖出来，现在用Primus，只需要证明“我在银行的资产比链上欠的钱多”就行，至于具体的银行卡号和流水明细？一个字都不用公开

也可以给AI Agent戴上“紧箍咒”：Primus支持给AI的每一次API调用和下单操作都开一张“防伪发票”，每一步都能对得上、可审计

告别“重复验证”：现在机构去玩各种DeFi，可以直接用Primus甩出一张合规的ZK证明，既能过监管审查，又不会把自己的隐私信息全部暴露

💡 个人的一些思考
比特币解决了资产的去中心化发行
以太坊解决了去中心化计算
那么Primus则是在解决万亿美元级传统资本上链前夕最关键的“信任与隐私清算”问题

当华尔街不再需要为隐私和信用担忧时，链上金融的真实万亿时代才算真正开启

而对于我们这种加密用户来说，永远不是等风来，而是提前布局的超前眼光显得尤为重要

text:
图拉鼎老师用 App Store + 两张不同的美国卡 + 同一套中国护照，开通了三个 Claude Pro，同一台电脑、同一个网络，目前仍然稳定。

问题就来了：支付方式（卡 / Google Play / App Store）、IP、身份、设备，到底哪个最重要？

昨天还看到一种说法“适合自己的最重要”，但这不是买菜做饭，并不包含太多个人喜好成分，从我的经验看：都重要，只是有权重区别。

按重要性排个序：

★★★★★ 一票否决
· 恶意退款
· 显著蒸馏特征
· 多次越狱，进行危险研究

★★★★ 高权重
· 支付工具质量（虚拟卡 / 预付卡 / 黑卡）
· 国家/区域一致：支付国 = IP 国 = 账号国 = 环境国
· 支付时的设备指纹

★★★ 中权重
· IP 类型与稳定性
· 设备 ID（ANDROID_ID / ant-did / userID）
· 同设备多号（被识别为蒸馏可能性增大）
· 档位（高额度 = 高滥用收益）

★ 低权重
· KYC 国籍（按地区而非国籍禁用）

（仅作机制分析，不构成绕过建议）

七巨头走势冰火两重天，谁在疯狂逃命？这 7 个关键价位决定生死！

1. SpaceX $SPCX
SpaceX 财报前从 145 一路冲到 175，随后又跌回 140 附近，日内波动和成交量都非常大，短期上涨趋势已经被破坏。目前 143 是关键支撑，只要没有有效跌破 $140，支撑逻辑就还在。

2. 特斯拉 $TSLA
特斯拉已经横盘震荡了一个月，370 是目前多空拉锯的中轴。350 是下方关键支撑，390 是上方压力，只要股价在这两个位置之间晃荡，就没有明确的方向。如果真有合并，股东可能获得溢价。

3. 谷歌 $GOOGL
谷歌最近明显走弱，连续 4 个交易日收跌，下跌过程中成交量有所放大，说明抛压不轻。股价跌破前期低点，正在向 310 附近靠拢。接下来要看 $320 一带能否形成止跌 K 线，例如长下影线、看涨吞没，或放量收复前一日高点。

4. 亚马逊 $AMZN
短线转弱，但长期趋势尚未彻底破坏，亚马逊目前也是反复震荡，关键看 248 附近能否守住，以及股价能否重新站回 255–256 的均线压力区。财报如果 AWS 增长强劲，股价可能迅速收复均线。

5. 苹果 $AAPL
科技股整体下跌，苹果却逆势创下历史新高，说明资金正在往更强势、更有确定性的公司集中。低点逐步抬高，随后震荡上行，整体仍处于上升结构。340-345 美元是关键支撑区，只要守住，短期仍然偏多。

6. 英伟达 $NVDA
短线明显走弱，但股价没跌破 200 日均线，中长期趋势尚未破坏。暂时看不到明显的强势反转 K 线。$203–205 是接下来值得重点观察的区域。如果股价回踩这里能够止跌，并重新站回 $217–222，调整有机会结束。

7. 微软 $MSFT
短线可以重点观察 520 一带能不能守住，这里是多空双方需要争夺的位置。如果失守，股价可能进一步测试 510 附近，反弹属于无量，还没有放量收复关键均线，资金还没真正回流。

不跌破关键支撑，出现止跌信号才是决定是否加仓的唯一标准！

text:
ZK Basics | Ep. 9: What Zypher actually does, step by step

Eight episodes of theory. Here's the product in four steps.

1. An AI agent does something — answers, scores, decides, trades.
2. Instead of just returning the output, the run is turned into a proof: this model, this input, this result.
3. The proof goes on-chain. It's small, and anyone can check it.
4. Anyone verifies in milliseconds. No access to the model. No access to your data. Just certainty that the claimed run is the one that happened.

Why it matters: today you trust an AI output because of who served it. That's a brand promise, not a guarantee.

With proofs, the guarantee is in the math. Nobody has to be trusted — including us💜

text:
[TL;DR 每日精选]

我盯上的不是GPU有多贵，而是它到底能不能像一个合格的智能体工厂那样，持续吐出可计费的“智能”。DeepSeek抛出的38美元/GPU小时，很像把AI产业最敏感的账本掀开了一角：问题不再只是烧了多少钱，而是每一张卡，究竟能不能自己赚回来。

📌 先看最抓眼球的数据
• DeepSeek披露：单集群每天可处理155万亿Token。
• 按公开API谷时价格折算，理论上平均每GPU小时对应38美元收入。
• 粗略年化外推，一张GPU可对应超33万美元计费产值。

这不是“利润”，更不是躺赚数字，只是理论计费能力。但它很关键——它说明推理优化如果做得足够狠，GPU未必只是成本黑洞，也可能成为生产现金流的机器。

📌 38美元是怎么逼出来的
• DeepSeek V4.1 Flash总参数5520亿，采用MoE架构。
• 处理输入时约激活80亿参数，生成输出时约激活160亿参数。
• 全局KV Cache占用降到上一代约1/4，长期缓存降到约1/8。
• 每Token全局KV Cache约890字节，最高支持100万Token上下文。

换句话说，它不是靠“更贵的卡”赚钱，而是靠更狠的系统工程：专家并行、推测解码、异步调度、Prefill/Decode分离，还有把KV Cache尽量留久一点。说白了，同样一堆GPU，谁能少做重复计算，谁就更接近印钞机。

📌 但别急着把38美元当成行业平均线
• DeepInfer并没有完整开源生产环境全部组件。
• KV Cache系统、服务编排、跨副本负载均衡等关键环节仍需外部补齐。
• 它目前主要适配DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash，其他模型很难直接照搬。

所以，下载框架 ≠ 复制收入。38美元更像“顶尖工程状态下的样板间”，不是谁拿几台GPU就能立刻复刻的财富密码。

📌 为什么推理越来越强，很多模型公司还是亏
• Stanford HAI / Epoch AI估算：OpenAI 2025年计算支出约163亿美元，其中研发83亿、推理80亿。
• 相比2024年，OpenAI推理支出从18亿增至80亿，约增长3.4倍。
• Anthropic 2025年计算支出约68亿美元，其中研发41亿、推理27亿。

这就是真相：训练和推理，是两本账。你能卖Token，不代表你不用继续烧钱做下一代模型；而用户越多，推理账单也会一起膨胀。单位成本降了，不代表总成本会降。AI行业很像开高速公路——车越多，收费越多，但维护、扩建、融资利息也一起上来。

📌 只卖Token，能不能做成生意？
答案是：可能可以，但不轻松。

文中给了一个很直白的敏感性测算：
• 如果完全负担成本是10美元/GPU小时；
• 满负载理论计费产值参考38美元/GPU小时；
• 那么只要实现约26.3%的有效计费产出，理论上可覆盖成本。
• 若有效计费产出达到50%，每小时收入约19美元，扣除10美元后还剩9美元。

这个模型挺迷人，但现实很不浪漫。吞吐、并发、延迟、客户结构、峰值流量、空载时间，都会吃掉想象中的利润。更别说，价格战一来，效率提升的一部分收益往往会让渡给客户。

📌 CoreWeave把另一面也演得很真实
• 2026年第二季度收入25.75亿美元，同比增长约112%。
• 调整后EBITDA 15.10亿美元，利润率59%。
• 但GAAP口径下仍净亏损6.26亿美元。
• 当季折旧及摊销13.93亿美元，净利息支出6.4亿美元。

看到没？算力生意不是“有收入=有利润”。GPU会折旧，扩张靠融资，利息像影子一样跟着你。赚得到毛利，不等于守得住净利。

📌 应用层更尴尬：需求在涨，盈利未必跟上
• Cursor截至2026年1月季度，毛利率一度-23%；若把免费用户推理费用全算进成本，约-31%。
• https://t.co/RxWvQzBAAu申请破产保护时仍有约1200万月活，2026年8月收入530万美元，但月亏损仍有800万-900万美元。
• 仅2026年前8个月，https://t.co/RxWvQzBAAu算力支出5610万美元，占运营费用约45%。
• 另一边，Midjourney 2023年收入显著超过2亿美元，并保持盈利。

同样是AI Native，命运差很多。原因也不神秘：不是“用了AI”就自动成立商业模式，关键在于任务价值能否覆盖推理和运营成本。

📌 更大的机会，也许在Agent
• Menlo Ventures估计，全球消费者AI支出在2026年已达400亿美元，较2025年的120亿美元翻了三倍多。
• 但美国成年人AI使用率只从61%升到64%。

也就是说，新增用户没爆炸，真正爆炸的是老用户用得更深、付费更多。市场开始赌的，不只是聊天次数，而是AI每天能替你完成多少任务。邮件、采购、排程、软件操作、跨服务协同——这些才是Agent真正可能放大Token消费的地方。

不过，我还是得泼一盆冷静的水：更多Token，不等于更好的商业。若一家Agent产品月收20美元，却要为模型和工具支出30美元，那它只是替上游养活GPU，并没有养活自己。

我的判断很简单：
1. 38美元/GPU小时说明，AI推理这门生意“可能成立”，而且工程优化的价值被严重低估了。
2. 但从“能计费”到“能盈利”，中间隔着利用率、定价权、资本成本、产品价值四道墙。
3. 真正能穿越周期的，不一定是最会烧卡的人，而是最会把Token变成真实任务结果的人。

如果未来每个Agent都在替人类工作、采购、谈判、执行流程，那问题就不再是“Token卖多少钱”，而是——我创造的这份智能，究竟替你赚回了多少价值？

这才是我最在意的账。

text:
The finding has large implications in itself (US productivity growth may have peaked before WWII rather than the postwar boom), but what fascinates me most is the method.

The authors use LLMs to extract prices and product characteristics from 5.1 million Sears catalog listings from 1900 to 1990. That lets them estimate how much prices for consumer goods rose after accounting for improvements in quality (e.g. icebox → electric fridge).

This opens up obscenely broad research agendas. Old books, catalogs, newspapers, imperial records, archives full of evidence that would be almost impossible to structure manually can now become datasets. Questions in economics, history and politics that were previously prohibitively labor intensive to investigate are now practical research projects.

text:
一个每天花将近 5 个小时执行固定流程的人，最近开始提醒大家千万别让自己活成一个 System。

Bryan Johnson 最近分享了一段关于晨间习惯的思考，我觉得挺有意思的。

今年他公布过自己的早晨安排，整套流程长达 4 小时 46 分钟。

早上 5 点自然醒，6 分钟呼吸练习或冥想，90 分钟运动，20 分钟桑拿，接着是红光护理、洗澡、护肤、早餐。每个环节都有明确的时间和目的。

但这一次，他谈的是另一件事，如何避免自己在日复一日的生活中，逐渐丧失独立思考的能力。

他说，人天生就喜欢遵循默认模式。别人做什么，我们就做什么。每天醒来开始处理消息、刷手机、回复邮件，忙着完成眼前的事情。

一天变成一年，一年变成十年。直到某天突然意识到，自己好像一直在忙，却不知道这些年究竟是怎么过去的。

他把这种状态称为成为「System」的一部分，被所处时代的默认规则同化，连思考都成了一种条件反射。

所以他特别珍惜早晨那段没有屏幕、没有消息、不受外界干扰的时间。

只有安静、自律带来的不适感，以及完全属于自己的思考空间。

我觉得 Bryan Johnson 最有意思的地方就在这里。

他把身体交给一套高度程序化的生活规则，却又极力保护自己不被外界的规则控制。

他也知道这种生活很难复制。自己有三个孩子，养孩子的人想保持完整的晨间习惯几乎不可能。但哪怕每天只有 15 分钟，他也觉得值得。

我越来越觉得，在这个时代，保持清醒其实是一件非常消耗精力的事情。

尤其现在有了 AI，我们可以把越来越多的工作、判断，甚至思考过程交给机器。

但每天醒来之后，能不能有那么一段时间，暂时停止接收别人的观点，想想自己到底相信什么、想做什么，可能会变得越来越重要。

最讽刺的是，我们已经拥有了历史上最丰富的信息获取能力，却可能正在失去独处和思考的耐心。

Maintaining a clear mind is the hardest challenge of life. 

By default we settle into patterns. We do what's easily available and pattern match what others do. 

Getting swept away by the day which turn into years. Awaking one day and wondering what even happened to the time. 

I've found my morning routine is the best antidote to becoming the System. That is, unthinkingly becoming the default patterns that dominate your era. 

Each day, it's time without screens, messages, scrolling, interruptions, and social pressures. 

It's filled with silence, the discomfort of discipline and the open space of thought. 

There is something magical about the morning. A time when life is reborn each day. I find my greatest solace and joy in them. 

p.s. those of you with kids, I hear you. I have three children. Morning routines are practically impossible. Hang in there and even if it's a 15 minute routine, it can be a good practice to maintain sanity amid the chaos.

text:
美国家庭的金融资产，有整整 48.2% 压在了股票上，创下了历史最高纪录。

这是个什么概念？

2000 年互联网泡沫最疯狂的时候，全美暴富神话满天飞，这个数字也不过是 38.7%；

2007 年次贷危机前夕，房地产与股市狂欢叠加，它也只有 33.5%。

而到了 2026 年第 2 季度，美国家庭近乎一半的金融身家，已经和 K 线图彻底捆绑在一起。

更有意思的地方在于，之前的历史峰值和今天有着截然不同的“气质”。

2000 年的时候，散户们疯狂打爆交易电话，买入任何名字带有 .com 的公司，以为自己踩中了新时代的风口；

而到了今天，绝大多数美国家庭甚至不怎么关心具体公司的财报，

他们只是在每个月的发薪日，任由 401(k) 退休养老计划把工资的固定比例自动划扣进标普 500 等指数基金里。

这根本不是一场狂热的投机运动，而是一场由制度、算法和自动化定投发动的“被迫梭哈”。

金融市场的高手们曾经以为自己在玩精密的估值模型、博弈宏观利率，结果发现全场最强大的买盘居然是那些对资产定价一无所知的上班族。

这种自动打款的机制形成了一个近乎无解的流动性飞轮：

发薪日一到，ETF 机械式地按市值权重扫货，市值越大的科技巨头获得的自动资金灌溉就越多，

股价被推得越高，权重进一步放大，下一轮发薪日买得更多。

资本市场的底层逻辑，悄然间从“价格发现”演化成了“自动化抽水机”。

当科技巨头们依靠 AI 基础设施、云服务和数字生态构筑起时代级别的“收费站”时，

普通人发现手握现金就像在夏天抱冰块，而除了把钱存进这些巨头的股权资产里，竟然找不到第二个能够有效对抗通胀的容器。

这就是当代宏观经济最诡异的悖论：

大家并不是因为“极度乐观”才买股票，而是因为在现有的金融结构下“别无选择”。

老一代投资者还在盯着美联储的降息点阵图，还在纠结沃伦·巴菲特手里又刷新纪录的现金储备。

但新一代的资金已经完成了闭环。

当近半数的美国家庭资产都绑在这台永动机上时，股市就已经不再是经济的“晴雨表”，

它自己就是经济本身——一个大到不能倒、强到不能落、甚至连政策制定者都必须小心翼翼护盘的终极系统。

以前大家常说“股市有风险，入市需谨慎”；

现在的情况是，整个社会的财富系统把保险柜直接建在了过山车上。

text:
I think Monero has value and is probably oversold but ultimately has a lower TAM than Zcash

At first I was a Monero maxi bc I believed in the absolutist view of privacy. All transactions have to be private or else the leakage makes the system non viable

I’ve come around. Money is a social technology. It exists within the context of our society and institutions

Look at a private Swiss bank account. What’s so dope about it? The fact that it’s still a fully functional bank account. The fact you can buy groceries, pay your mortgage, etc… all from the bank account is what makes it dope. If the Swiss account was rejected in 19/20 venues, or you could only buy drugs with it, it would be inherently less valuable

This is the root issue with Monero. Is it private money? Yes. Is it good private money? No, or at least it’s less useful private money. Institutions cannot come around to integrating Monero for the simple fact that sometimes in society, you just have to prove your money is not from terrorist money laundering

Monero is also just less competent than Zcash, which matters during this time of AI stress. No formal verification, No quantum resistance, FCMP++ is cool but on an unknown timeline, etc…

text:
As a young man and confirmed Catholic I did what any good GATE program attendee would do in order to gain acceptance from peers while also rebelling against the authorities I was so naturally repulsed by: I studied and parroted my way into becoming a rabid atheist and anti-theist. Hitchens and Dawkins would have been proud of 15 year-old Dan’s level of recall and snark that he mistook for intelligence and wit. As a chubby and not-physically-talented teen, this was my preferred method of rebellion since not quite all of the cool-kid-options (sex, booze, drugs, parties) were available (yet).

Fast forward to life now in my 40s as a Christian and a man still constantly seeking purpose, role models, motivation, and somehow peace amidst all of that, and I’m starting to notice a potentially more insidious character flaw in myself, and potentially other men in vaguely similar situations. That flaw is something I’ll just call “drift”.

We didn't rush out and slam the gate. We didn't curse the Shepherd. We, who accept and even embrace our role in the Lord’s flock, just put our heads down and kept eating. One patch of grass led to the next, and the next, and the next, until one day we looked up and couldn't hear His voice anymore.

That's what I mean by “drift”. It’s not rebellion in the 15 year-old Dan sense. It’s something quieter and more slippery.

Maybe drift is the same as wandering? Fine maybe so, but hear me: a short season of wandering is still wandering. "All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way." (Isaiah 53:6)

Every one. Not some of us. ALL of us.

So how does a sheep drift? Head down. Comfort. Distraction. Chasing grass instead of righteousness. The next TikTok, the next Reel, the next Short, the next small thing that feels… maybe not “good” but surely good enough.

Nothing in that field looks dangerous. It all looks benign at worst, but sometimes downright bucolic. That's exactly why you never look up or look out, but instead just keep nibbling away mindlessly or even blissfully at the next patch of grass till you’re eventually out of earshot of the Shepherd.

Jesus said, "My sheep hear my voice." (John 10:27) but eventually you can no longer hear a voice you've drifted from. Prayer gets shorter, then it gets skipped. The Word sits closed. The Shepherd's voice doesn't stop, but just gets softer, and then we manage to drift out of range of the still small voice entirely. Away from the flock. The lost sheep is alone and isolation is where the drift picks up speed because nobody was close enough to notice you've gone.

I know the retort you might be feeling, at least it’s the one in my gut as I proofread and edit this thing… something like a Thanos-style “I’ll do it myself”. But please hear me, brothers; the sheep, by itself, is prey for the adversarial forces that lurk in the tall grasses and shadows of verdant pastures. The lone sheep has no claws, no speed, no armor and it certainly can't fight the wolf or even confound the coyotes. Out there by itself, it’s just dinner for those others that seek it.

So why don't we just turn around and walk back to the flock where we last saw our Shepherd? They can’t have gone that far, right?

Because sheep have no sense of direction home, no clear moment of exactly where we lost our way, or exactly which patch of grass pulled us just far enough away to make it a problem. The lost sheep doesn't find its way back. It just keeps moving. When we try harder in our own strength, all we do is drift even better, even faster, even farther than before.
Self-rescue sounds noble or heroic, but it's simply pride in disguise. "I got myself into this. I'll get myself out." 

Brother… No. You won’t.

I struggle even now to accept this, but the fix is surrender, not struggle.
What does a lost sheep do? It cries out. Plainly.

Pray it word for word: "I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant." (Psalm 119:176) 

Not "I'll find you, Lord." but instead “SEEK ME, Lord.”

Next, STOP DRIFTING. Be still where you are and let Him come. "What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?" (Luke 15:4)

He leaves the ninety-nine. He goes after the one.

That’s you… right now it’s me.

Get back in earshot. Open the Word. Pray every day, even when it feels dry, even when it feels like talking to a ceiling, or talking to your hands. You're not earning your way back. That’s not an option. You're making a decision to turn and look back in the direction of the voice that's already been calling.
Reach toward the flock, even if you can't see it yet. Maybe you’re like me and don't have a church family right now, there's no brother or sister you can call tonight. Reach anyway. Speak up. Say it out loud, to the ones you haven't even met yet.

If you're out there drifting too, you're not the only one, I promise you.

Brothers, trust Him to do the finding. "As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day." (Ezekiel 34:12)

That's His promise. The finding is His job.

If your childhood was like mine, you’d be expecting the belt once you’re finally home, but the Word tells us plainly that when the Shepherd finds that sheep, He doesn't scold it, and He doesn't drive it home with the rod or staff "when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing." (Luke 15:5)

Carried home. Rejoicing.

So wherever you've drifted, for however long, however quietly it happened, please call out today. Don't try to find your own way back. Let Him find you.

"For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls." (1 Peter 2:25)

Returned. Not by your own strength. By His.

text:
ngl, I think @calilyliu puts the ceiling FAR too low here: 

Permissionless capital markets are an enormous opportunity. But Solana should aim to sit below finance: a shared layer for coordinating finance, ownership, contributions, commitments, and rewards.

Unified liquidity is clearly compatible with that ambition.

Communities, researchers, creators, and infrastructure operators can use the same underlying network for very different ends.

And I think we should be careful about declaring those experiments exhausted just as AI changes the economics of building them.

Cheaper production doesn’t mean the experiments we tried last time will work this time but it does give us a VERY compelling reason to revisit the thesis behind them.

Finance is a compelling place to start. Why make it the boundary?
author: KEMOS4BE
quoted_text:
Depending on who you talk to, our industry growing up is either doom or glory.

We are finally globally relevant and that necessarily means we are less insular. 

Because this industry was created by the stubborn resolute and unwavering conviction of contrarians, misfits, and fringe actors, we relished in the pirate mindset. We loved our insularity. (Tbh, I miss it too at times).

The “web3” thesis where programmable blockchains are supposed to be decentralized computing infrastructure for many apps ultimately incinerated billions of dollars of venture capital because it led tech minded builders and their investors to prioritize app sovereignty over unified liquidity. This was wrong on first principles.

As it turns out, blockchain has and always will be financial infrastructure. Finance superpowered by tech and programmability. Decentralization, neutrality, and censorship resistance have never been more important. 

Whether this excites you going forward depends on whether you’re more west coast or east coast; San Francisco or New York; more tech or finance minded.

From the west coast crowd, I often hear disappointment (“oh in the end blockchain is only about finance?! That’s it?”)

I couldn’t be more excited, and I think the mandate has never been more clear and also attainable.

Capital formation isn’t an abstract thing that bankers do when you are ready to IPO.

Capital formation enables innovation. It allows us to take big bets on the future. Liquid markets enable capital formation. Over the long term, there can not be a larger global capital market than the internet capital market. The biggest market to possibly unify is that of people on the internet who use money.

Like all things the internet has ever touched, the online/onchain experience is never the same as the pre internet experience. Just as we needed network engineers to imagine and build blockchain networks, we need consumer tech minds to complement finance minds to deliver new ways of accessing finance.

This is not and has never been a small vision for blockchain. In fact, I would argue that it’s a core intent of a “peer to peer electronic cash network.”

We welcome those who want to double down on finance for the internet to come join the Solana ecosystem and make good on this mission.

I think it’s fine and even great that the risk-on talent from blockchain is now expanding new frontiers away from blockchain. New frontiers are only ever explored by those with stubborn resolute unwavering conviction.

text:
What Jack meant by there is no moat is that many of the future companies will eventually look very similar even though they all started in completely different sectors and you’re already starting to see bits of this now

Square e.g Payments -> Lending & Payroll -> Business Operations -> Applied AI Lab

Ramp e.g Corporate Cards -> Expense Management -> Back Office Operations -> Applied AI Lab

Stripe e.g Payments -> Financial Infrastructure -> Applied AI Lab

Shopify e.g Online Storefronts -> Payments & Fulfillment -> Merchant Operations -> Applied AI Lab

What’s interesting is that all these companies started from completely different entry points, but over time they’re starting to look more and more similar and eventually will compete with each other in some form 

I think ai is going to accelerate this, making it much easier for companies to expand into markets that historically would’ve taken years to enter 

My take is that companies are going to look more like pods of interconnected businesses vs operating in one singular sector and I believe a lot of sectors will start to merge

e.g there won’t be a fintech sector, it’ll be a merge of finance, commerce, software and intelligence all bundled together. The same could happen with compute, energy, and finance, or media, commerce, and advertising etc

And as these sectors merge, companies that never competed with each other will start competing for the same customers

Think companies that are extremely ai forward are thinking about how many sectors they can bring together under one company vs the ones that have been skeptical or too slow to move

text:
The only way out is through. 

They're calling it the Bugpocalypse. LLMs are being used to find long-hidden cracks in the software infrastructure, and it's happening at a furious rate. 3% of all compromises in computing history happened in the last week, claims one source? I believe it.

There are people saying public access to the frontier models ought to be locked out, or heavily guardrailed, over this. The problem with that idea can be summed up in one sentence: when lockpicks are outlawed, only outlaws will have lockpicks.

The lockpicks will be Chinese open-weight models, if nothing else. There's no way to stop those from becoming ubiquitous.

There are two futures in front of us. One in which only the bad guys have lockpicks, and security holes go undiscovered until they're exploited. Another in which everybody has lockpicks and is aggressively red-teaming their own software so it gets fixed before the holes are exploited. 

The corpus of human code is huge but finite. The number of defects in it has to be finite too. We can fix those defects now; we have a million friendly robots to do it with.

The only way out is through.

有些人手里有 USDC，想赚借款利息；有些交易应用有用户和策略，用户却只有有限的本金。两边一直都在，只是把它们接起来，远比在页面上加一个「借款」按钮麻烦。

举个例子：你在 Hyperliquid 上有 500U 购买力，其中 100U 是自己的，另外 400U 是借来的。开仓时看到的是一个仓位，背后却还有一笔债。借钱的人要付利息；行情反过来时，借出去的 400U 又该由谁保护？

@leveracc_xyz 想接住的就是这部分。出资人把 USDC 放进 Fund Vault，交易者用自有资金申请借款，官方设计的上限是再借入本金的 4 倍。AI 交易、跟单和量化应用继续做自己的策略与用户体验；LeverAcc 管账户、授信、风控和结算，订单在 Hyperliquid 执行。

对交易应用来说，这样就不用自己筹钱、搭借贷系统了。但策略由合作应用决定，借款风险却要由 LeverAcc 管。Bot 可以随时调整仓位，风控系统得决定账户还能借多少，以及什么时候该触发保护。出资人不参与交易决策，仍然会关心本金能不能收回来。

行情急跌时，这套分工会变得棘手。不同应用的用户可能押在相近方向，一批仓位同时触发风控。处置单个账户的规则写得再清楚，也要看许多账户同时触发时能不能执行。

出资人愿不愿意继续把钱留在 Fund Vault，很大程度取决于这些时刻的处理结果。借款顺利了结，资金才能支持下一笔交易；合作应用看见流程跑得通，也才愿意把它接进日常产品。LeverAcc 想做的共享资金层，最终都会靠这一笔笔借款给跑出来。

LeverAcc目前还在beta内测阶段，期待它的后续表现

text:
There is an absolute barrage of inference providers popping up that get to $1M/mo extremely quickly.

This is the rough economics of inference providers:

Even if you rent on-demand B300s at $8/GPU-hr, many open source models (GLM 5.3, Kimi K3, DeepSeek 4.1 Flash / Pro) can get you >$10-20/GPU-hr at reasonable throughputs (100tok/s). DeepInfer from DeepSeek directly shows they can get $38/GPU-hr on off-peak hours. Every chip / model has a different throughput / interactivity curve, but there is a lot of arbitrage between even high rental spot prices and token prices. New chips (Vera Rubins) also change this meaningfully. Your ability to be making gross margin relies on your utilization and how good your stack is.

Gateways like OpenRouter, Vercel and more help solve that problem by aggregating demand to you. May inference providers discount their tokens to get longer term commits too. I've even heard stories of selling back Chinese model tokens to Chinese labs!

One thorn in the economics of these players is that many Chinese open source model labs are now asking for rev share if you're at a certain scale, espp for pre-release access to their models for day 1 support. That further pushes the threshold to be in the money.

The barrier to entry seems low and falling. There are even stories of smaller ones who can "vibe code" a way to stand up OSS models on a cluster they rent. And as a result, we're seeing 10s of such companies pop up almost every week and immediately skyrocketing revenue at low-ish gross margin and raising rounds on the back of that.

Unsurprisingly, because the actual service provided seems commodity, this eventually drives up compute prices and drives down token prices. In theory, it would seem like neoclouds who have the lowest cost of compute and themselves have started inference businesses would win the race to the bottom (Crusoe Coreweave Nebius and GMI all have inference businesses), with larger players (Modal Fireworks Baseten) being second because they are well capitalized to make bigger compute commits cheaply and have demand (high utilization), but the reality is the pie is growing so quickly that even upstarts are absolutely crushing it and growing aggressively (inference dot net, DeepInfra, Wafer, Relace, Morph).

Strategies vary across the board: neoclouds want to serve inference, inference players want to be neoclouds and do higher margin reserved instances / post training, and some want to go heterogeneous hardware or creatively flexible compute constructs.

The risks are: do open source models continue to be competitive? Will their creators rent seek more? Will their shape change compute needs? How do different chips change economics? Who gets compute in a supply crunch?

Below is a aggressive sketch of how gross margin scales with utilization for various models / chip sets.

For now, there are many inference providers and they’re all ripping!

可能的原因有以下几点：

目前2980元VIP课程仍在售卖。

2.  金融产品网络营销新规（“930新规”）
2026年9月30日起正式施行的《金融产品网络营销管理办法》明确：非金融机构从业人员不得通过公众号、直播、短视频等形式营销金融产品，特别是变相荐股或开展非法证券投资咨询。
新规落地后，不少财经大V、基金博主账号受限或被迫调整。有报道提到，任泽平团队称部分内容因技术调整和不符合新规要求而受影响。这与当前限制时间点较为吻合。⁠

3. 历史多次受限2022年：因呼吁央行多印2万亿刺激生育，微博被禁言。
2024年：与但斌隔空互怼后公众号/视频号被限；疑因发汉武帝《轮台诏》被指“以古喻今”而被禁言。

text:
While this is a take that has been parroted many times before, it remains the most incel coded one. For someone who has had serious relationships in their lives, the absurdity of this statement is obvious. 

But for those who have yet to feel the love and warmth of a human partner, I will say this: love is hard. It it takes a lot of work and it will often end in misery and heartbreak. But that is what makes love so worthwhile. You meet another human being and you decide that, between the two of you, you want to create something new, something that has never existed before: your relationship. 

What makes life worth living is these idiosyncratic, often ugly, mistakes that we as human beings make as we stumble through this farcicle existence that we call the human condition. This is why an AI "relationship" can by definition never be real. A relationship is about learning about who someone else is, learning about who you are, and learning about how you can render certain wants and needs of yourself to that greater whole.

An algorithm built upon fine tuning the parameters of a matrix to maximize the probability of the user accepting an output is not a basis for love.

I love math, most of my professional career has been predicated upon using math to solve problems. But, I'm sorry, I find it very difficult to believe that love and the nature of the human condition can be simply reduced to linear algebra.

If there's one thing that my life has taught me, it's that human beings exist in a state of infinite diversity in infinite combinations and if you believe that the human experience can be distilled into a set of parameters in a matrix, then, I'm sorry, but you need to get laid. Because humanity is not that simple.

text:
UNI ve AERO'yu karşılaştırınca ortaya oldukça ilginç bir tablo çıkıyor. Uniswap, 4,29 milyar dolarlık piyasa değeriyle Aerodrome'dan yaklaşık 7 kat daha büyük. TVL tarafında da aralarında uçurum var. Uniswap'ın 4 milyar dolarlık TVL'sine karşılık Aerodrome'un yalnızca 381 milyon doları bulunuyor. Ancak iş işlem hacmine gelince fark ciddi biçimde kapanıyor. Uniswap son 30 günde 75 milyar dolar, Aerodrome ise 15,67 milyar dolar işlem hacmi üretmiş. Yani Aerodrome, çok daha az sermayeyle oldukça yüksek bir işlem hacmine ulaşmayı başarıyor. Bence burada dikkat edilmesi gereken nokta, bu hacmin ne kadarının gerçek kullanıcı talebinden, ne kadarının teşviklerden kaynaklandığı.

Beni asıl şaşırtan ise gelirleri oldu. Son 30 günde Uniswap 7,88 milyon dolar, Aerodrome ise 7,85 milyon dolar gelir üretmiş. Aralarında piyasa değeri bakımından yedi kat fark olmasına rağmen gelirleri neredeyse aynı. Üstelik AERO'nun token ekonomisi, kilitleme ve ücret paylaşımı sayesinde protokol gelirleriyle daha doğrudan bağlantılı. Ancak madalyonun diğer yüzünde ciddi bir arz baskısı bulunuyor. AERO sürekli yeni token üretiyor ve bu durum uzun vadede fiyat üzerinde baskı oluşturabilir. UNI ise yakım mekanizması ve daha oturmuş ekosistemiyle avantajlı. Bana kalırsa UNI daha güvenli bir yapı sunarken AERO değerleme açısından daha ilginç görünüyor.
